bug_semantics: The local MCP request-approval path accepts caller-controlled categoryName and passes it to ApprovalStorage.createApproval. Vulnerable versions used join(this.approvalsDir, categoryName), then recursively created that path and wrote `${id}.json` beneath it. A categoryName containing parent components and platform separators (the first-party Windows reproduction used `..\..\..\spec-workflow-poc-outside`) therefore normalized outside `.spec-workflow/approvals`, allowing a locally authorized MCP caller to create a directory and approval JSON file outside the intended storage root. The separate filePath checks did not constrain categoryName.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable data flow and sink were created together in the repository's root commit b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4: src/tools/request-approval.ts accepted categoryName as an unconstrained string and passed it directly to ApprovalStorage.createApproval, while src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts created `join(this.approvalsDir, categoryName)` and wrote an approval JSON file there. This is the earliest and smallest commit present in the complete reachable history that writes the vulnerable lines; it is an initial 0.0.1 root commit rather than a later move, refactor, revert, release backport, or squash merge.
ai_marker: No AI commit-object marker on BIC b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4. `git cat-file -p b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4` shows author and committer `Pimzino <jose@freitasuk.com>` and a 0.0.1 release-style message, with no Co-Authored-By AI identity, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, or other AI attribution. The Claude marker on the later fix commit and the PR's generated-with disclosure are deliberately excluded because only the BIC commit object controls this judgment.
evidence: First-party report https://github.com/Pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp/issues/220 identifies version 2.2.6, the caller-controlled categoryName flow from src/tools/approvals.ts into ApprovalStorage.createApproval, the raw category join, and an observed Windows write outside the approvals tree using `..\..\..\spec-workflow-poc-outside`. The bundle's GHSA description independently states affected through 2.2.6 and fixed in 2.2.7 by 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe.

At b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4, `git show b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4:src/tools/request-approval.ts` shows inputSchema.categoryName as an arbitrary string and requestApprovalHandler passing args.categoryName into createApproval. `git show b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4:src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts` shows createApproval lines 73-102 computing `const categoryDir = join(this.approvalsDir, categoryName)`, calling `fs.mkdir(categoryDir, { recursive: true })`, and writing `${id}.json` under categoryDir without validating categoryName.

BIC tracing is reproducible with `git log --all --reverse --format='%H %P %s' -S'join(this.approvalsDir, categoryName)' -- src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts`, which reports root commit b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4 adding the expression and 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe removing it. Independently, `git log -L '/  async createApproval(/','/^  }/':src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts` traces the vulnerable createApproval body directly to b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4; intervening commits only extend or modify the function while retaining the raw category join.

Direct parent verification: `git rev-list --parents -n 1 b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4` prints only the commit SHA, and `git cat-file -p b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4` has tree/author/committer/message headers but no parent header. The pre-commit state is therefore the empty repository and cannot contain the vulnerable file or lines; introducer_parent is null and introducer_parent_absent is true.

The BIC is not a move or squash merge: `git show --stat --summary b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4` shows src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts and src/tools/request-approval.ts created in the 0.0.1 root commit, and the commit has zero parents. No member-commit decomposition exists for a zero-parent initial commit, so squash_decomposed is false and decomposed_shas is empty.

Version boundary: `git show b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4:package.json` reports 0.0.1, establishing that the public root release already contains the flaw. The repository's available early tags v0.0.25 and v0.0.28 both contain the BIC, and their package manifests report 0.0.25 and 0.0.28. Immediately before the fix, `git show d71a301d9ecfe4f603d3b48c88240de82a066b99:package.json` reports 2.2.6; `git show 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe:package.json` reports 2.2.7. The clone has no tag pointing at or containing the fix, so the 2.2.7 boundary is manifest/advisory-based rather than a Git-tag claim.

Fix verification: `git show 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe -- src/tools/approvals.ts src/dashboard/approval-storage.ts src/core/path-utils.ts package.json CHANGELOG.md` shows tool-boundary rejection of categoryName containing `..`, `/`, or `\`, storage-layer rejection of separators, replacement of raw category joins with PathUtils.safeJoin, and the 2.2.6 to 2.2.7 version bump. In that commit PathUtils.safeJoin rejects any path segment containing `..` or starting with `/` and performs a resolved containment check. Thus 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe directly closes the reported escape; follow-up 1ef0112ba8eda2e1ecc2666c3ad8d1f91393d886 centralizes and further hardens the validation but is not the first closing commit.

BIC-only AI check: `git cat-file -p b66281c495aa93e58da69c9227ac5506c16d0ca4` shows author/committer `Pimzino <jose@freitasuk.com>` and no trailers or bot identity. Although `git cat-file -p 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe` contains `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>` and PR #222 says it was generated with Claude Code, those are fix-only signals and do not alter the BIC verdict under the protocol.
reasoning: The vulnerability is a direct source-to-sink path: a local MCP caller controls categoryName, the tool forwards it unchanged, and createApproval uses it as a filesystem path component before mkdir/write. Both -S and -L histories converge on the zero-parent 0.0.1 commit as the first writer, and the lack of a parent directly proves absence before that commit. The advisory-named commit 9c7a7839e690bb4543f0e7481b5740d23808e5fe is a direct fix: it validates at the handler and storage boundaries, changes category construction to a containment-enforcing safeJoin, and bumps the manifest from vulnerable 2.2.6 to fixed 2.2.7. The BIC commit object has a human identity and no AI attribution. Later Claude attribution belongs only to the fix and must be ignored, so the evidence supports NOT_AI rather than an AI verdict.
